weeks.content:
Return the toy I borrowed
Do not take what is not mine

Wait for my turn quietly
Good things come to those who wait

Help a friend who fell
Carry for someone smaller

Count to ten when I am angry
Use words, not hands

Thank God and my parents
Say thank you without being told

Share my sweets and toys
Giving makes everyone happy

Do what I said I would do
Be a child of my word

Apologise even when it is hard
Sorry fixes friendship

Act honest, patient and kind
Talk about our best moment
